name: Koalafication Palmy 2019
information: Koalafication Palmy 2019 is open to competitors of all ages and ability. If you can solve the puzzle in under 10 minutes then you can enter. Entry for spectators is free for whats sure to be a fun filled day. This competition will feauture events that are held less frequently with the main purpose being to act as a qualifier for this years WCA World Championship being held in Melbourne Australia. For more information, visit the [WCA World Championship 2019 website](https://wc2019.speedcubing.org.au/en/).
